text: ポケモン　２ひき　つれてきて！

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる added to a て-form verb means doing it and then coming here. つれてきて = 'bring them along'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: Ending a sentence on the て-form is a casual way to ask someone to do something, like てください without the ください. つれてきて = 'bring them, please'.
